platform.unit: egui logical point; not CSS print point
platform.ownership: Consumer-side toolkit; applications supply inspection data and execute returned commands.
platform.componentRepresentation: Native descriptions and source symbols; no HTML/CSS previews or raster assets.
platform.tonalRamps: No tonal ramps are defined by the implementation; no synthetic colors are normative.

heading.purpose: Page headings and proportional summary values.

section.purpose: Section headings with egui strong emphasis.

mono.purpose: Inspection values, phase durations, coordinates and event timestamps.

breakpoints.name: inspection-two-columns
breakpoints.value: available content width >= 760 logical points and controls exist

nativeWindow.title: Fate / Diagnostics
nativeWindow.dwmFallback: Retain OS defaults if cosmetic attributes are rejected.
nativeWindow.rendering: Separate GPU context; use non-sRGB surface format when supported for egui gamma-space blending.

layout.pageBody: vertical scroll; header and shell remain outside

charts.xAxis: oldest to newest; uniformly spaced sample indices
charts.gpuSemantics: Completed asynchronous scene-pass durations; excludes acquire, present and gaps; not CPU-frame aligned.

frozen.label: FROZEN
frozen.scope: CPU and GPU streams only; inspection and events stay live.

states.gpuUnavailable: Timestamp queries are unavailable on the scene device.

exportFailure.message: Export failed: <error>. Check the directory and retry.

reviewEvidence.status: Parent reports finish review shipped after validating all eleven fresh native captures; documentation pass visually sampled desktop and narrow.

components.name: Panel
components.description: Native panel(ui): tonal fill, fine stroke, rounded corners and shared inset.

components.name: Button
components.description: egui button with weak widget fill, shared padding and lime hover/active stroke; focus and disabled behavior inherited.

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Persistent left rail; selected variant references navigation-selected. Consumer capabilities determine available pages.

components.name: Text field
components.description: Single-line native egui TextEdit for filters and export directory.

components.name: Session status
components.description: Bottom rail with uptime, submitted/skipped counts and companion identity.

components.name: Trace chart
components.description: chart(ui): painter-drawn sampled lines, shared millisecond axis, budget and nearest-index hover.

components.name: Inspection and tools
components.description: inspector(ui) and controls(ui): wrapping facts plus consumer-supplied actions, toggles and bounded numeric controls.

components.name: Capture
components.description: capture(ui): retained trace counts, clipboard/report/CSV actions, editable directory and explicit success/failure feedback.

narrative.overview: A compact, workhorse inspection companion: forest-black canvas, green-tinted panels, fine borders and lime selection. Proportional labels establish hierarchy; monospace inspection values make precise readings easy to compare. Charts and real controls carry the identity rather than imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Compact persistent navigation and scrollable inspection content.
Tonal green layering with restrained, semantic color.
Measured, bounded traces with explicit live and frozen states.
Native window behavior and code-drawn graphics.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Frame interval, CPU work and GPU pass duration are different measurements; never merge their meanings.

rules.name: The Trace Rule
rules.body: Freeze holds both retained streams; inspection and events remain live.

dos: Do retain the compact green shell, semantic trace colors and native window controls.
Do distinguish measured streams and label unavailable or waiting data honestly.
Do keep presentation consumer-owned and execute host tools through returned commands.
Do preserve available-width stacking and vertical scrolling.
donts: Don't fabricate telemetry or expose inactive placeholder tools.
Don't equate freezing a trace with pausing the host.
Don't replace the native UI with HTML/CSS or generated raster decoration.
Don't turn incidental egui defaults into explicit project-wide tokens.
